title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: The finale was widely viewed as satisfying, heartfelt, and a strong conclusion.
Many commenters praised the show's distinctive blend of horror, comedy, supernatural elements, and slice-of-life material.
The central character relationships were repeatedly described as lovable, funny, wholesome, and emotionally effective.
Several viewers considered the series an unexpected favorite or one of the season's biggest surprises.
The main action sequence was generally considered effective, though some felt it was too brief.
Some manga readers found the adaptation very good overall but noted a few questionable or unusual creative choices.
Multiple commenters were disappointed that the season ended without a clear continuation announcement and wanted more episodes or another season.
A few comments expressed disappointment with particular presentation choices, including the lack of a more dramatic musical payoff.
